evidenceBoundary.exact: Independent Int32Enum entries, complete owned windows and selected whole entry-to-RET traces. Other owned paths are retained as bytes without promoted semantics.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Buffered signed header, actual bridge pointer comparison with the selected scalar entry, four-byte output/cursor transfer and spare-capacity DWORD insertion.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Stable valid reader/list/output storage, ready contexts, normal ABI calls, fresh post-prepare pointer equals the compiled Int32Enum scalar entry, sufficient buffer/capacity, no external or aliased interference. Loops assume every child returns under these conditions.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: DamageType normalization/class/cache identity and concrete generic sharing, live provider choice, allocation/growth/refill/barrier effects and parent/root admission.
